title: The rule book
contentsMargin: Rules are grouped by theme. In each theme, the rules still waiting for evidence come first.
licence: The rules and their words are CC BY 4.0. Each dataset keeps its own licence, listed on the sources page.
intro1: This book holds every rule behind the game. Each rule is written as data. It says what it reads, what it changes, how long it takes and how sure we are. It lists its sources too.
intro2: You can change any rule that has a dial. The game then plays your version. It says so on every screen until you put the rules back.
placeholders: {n} of the {of} rules are rough guesses for now. They keep the game working, but their evidence is thin or missing. They are marked wherever they appear.
missing.title: There is no such page
missing.body: That page is not in the rule book. The contents list every rule and section.
kind.linear: Straight line: the result moves in step with what goes in. Each step adds the same amount.
kind.saturating: Levels off: each go helps less than the last. Or the total stops at a ceiling.
kind.stock: Builds up: a store that carries from turn to turn. Things add to it and drain from it.
kind.threshold: Tipping point: nothing happens until a level is crossed. Then an event can happen by chance.
kind.fcm: Web of causes: pressures on Welsh nature push on each other until they settle. It comes from the SoNaRR model.
kind.io: Spending into jobs: money spent in Wales creates work, worked out from the Wales input-output tables.
evidence.assessed: Official: in SoNaRR or official statistics.
rule.placeholder: Rough guess. This rule keeps the game working, but the evidence behind it is thin. Treat it as a question, not an answer.
rule.gameRule: Game rule. It is a choice that keeps the game fair, not a claim about Wales.
rule.lagTerms.one: Starts to work {n} turn (4 years) later
rule.paramsIntro: The game tries many futures. Each one picks a value from this range. Move a dial to set the middle value. The small triangle marks the default.
slider.fixed: Fixed at {v}. A rule of the game, so you cannot change it.
slider.changed: Changed by you. The default is {v}.
slider.placeholder: This value is a rough guess, waiting for evidence.
indicators.title: Measures and scores
indicators.blurb: The real measures, their latest values, and how each is scored.
indicators.margin: Score ranges come from model/bands.yaml. A measure with no range is shown for context only.
indicators.intro: Each measure is a real figure for every council area. To count towards a goal, it gets a score from 0 to 10. A table sets which value scores 0 and which scores 10.
strands.title: The seven goals and what makes them
strands.blurb: The seven goals, and the measures inside each one.
strands.margin: Life now feeds Life in your years. What is built up feeds Left for 2050. The result is the weaker of the two.
strands.intro: Each goal is one of the seven well-being goals in Welsh law. Each has two parts. Life now is how people are doing today. What is built up is what will be left for 2050. Each is the average of the parts listed.
cards.title: Cards
cards.margin: The colour shows where a card works. Buff: all of Wales. Green: a region. Pink: two regions. Blue: extra coins.
cards.intro: The choices you can make in the game. Each card costs coins from the turn’s budget. Many take years to start working. You can only read them here.
curveballs.title: Slow changes and crises
curveballs.blurb: What can happen to Wales, and which cards help.
curveballs.margin: Each slow change comes from a real trend that experts watch. A crisis can only come from a slow change already under way.
curveballs.intro: The slow changes and sudden crises the game can deal you. You can only read them here.
sources.title: Sources
sources.blurb: Every dataset and paper, with its licence.
sources.margin: Licences marked “verify” are believed open, but not yet confirmed on the publisher’s page.
sources.intro: Where every figure and rule comes from. Each dataset keeps its own licence.
changed.title: Your changes
changed.none: You have not changed any setting. The game plays the normal rules.
changed.intro: These settings are different from normal. Games you start now play these rules.
attributions.title: Attributions and licences
attributions.blurb: The exact credit each dataset asks for, and its licence.
attributions.intro: Every dataset the game and atlas use. Each has the credit its publisher asks for, word for word, and its licence. The credits keep their original wording.
attributions.margin: The Open Government Licence v3.0 asks you to credit the source and link to the licence. Each entry gives both.
attributions.logos: Logos and third party material are not covered by these licences and are not used.
attributions.checkedOn: Checked on 26 November 2026 against each publisher’s own page. This records what each publisher states and is not legal advice.
attributions.unconfirmed: No licence is stated for this table. We have asked for written confirmation. The figures stay flagged until it arrives.
